The '''Vensenor Flight Academy''' was a prestigious [[Starship/Legends|starship]] pilot training facility on [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]].

==History==
The facility was located on board a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Vensenor/Legends|''Vensenor'']], which was how the school got its name.<ref name="EGTW" /> The Vensenor Flight Academy was a branch of the [[Flight school/Legends|Imperial flight school system]], which was itself a branch of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].

A notable attendee was [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]].<ref name="DBPC">{{DB|character|pashcracken|Cracken, Pash}}</ref> [[Bythen Forral/Legends|Bythen Forral]] was an instructor for the Academy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|mole]] at the Academy was [[Gola Chall/Legends|Gola Chall]].<ref name="LCS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
